segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: John, I’ve just had some good news. Susan has had her baby.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Do you know when she had it?

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Yesterday. The tenth of August.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Oh, my father was born on August the tenth. Give me the details and I’ll make a note for everyone at work.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Well, was it a boy or a girl?

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: It’s a boy.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: And what are they going to call him?

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Tom. Tom Lightfoot. It sounds quite good, don’t you think?

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Yes, that has quite a good ring to it.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: You know he’s quite a big baby. He weighed four and a quarter kilos when he

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: was born. That does sound big, four and a quarter kilos.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: And he’s long too, forty-six centimetres.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Mmmm. Tall parents. He’ll grow up to be over two metres, I’d say.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: With masses of black hair, curly black hair. You know, we should go and visit them in hospital. What about tomorrow afternoon at around 1 pm?

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Yes, OK.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Where should we meet? ... Ah, I could come and pick you up at your house, if you like.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Yes, that would be wonderful. My car is still off the road.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Just refresh my memory. What’s the address again?

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: It’s 15 Chesterfield Road, Paddington.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: It’s next to the library, isn’t it?

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Not exactly. It’s next to a bank. The State Bank actually. The library is opposite / us, on the corner.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: That’s right, and there’s a garage on the other street corner. I remember now.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: So, you’ll pick me up at a quarter to one and we’ll be there at one easily.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Now what should we take? We must take them something.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: I always think flowers are good to take to someone in hospital, don’t you?

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Well, not really. Everyone always brings flowers and they don’t last. I think it’s much better to take a pot plant, so she can take it home with her.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Yes, but then she has to remember to water it. What about a big box of chocolates?

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: OK, chocolates sound fine. We should get something for the baby too. What do you think?

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Yes, you’re right. What do you think of something like baby shampoo or talcum powder?

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Or we could get a little hat, or something like that.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: We don’t know the size, or the right colour, do we?

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: I think we should get something they wouldn’t normally buy. What about a soft toy of some sort?

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: Yes, a soft toy.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: What about a teddy bear?

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: I could get one early tomorrow at the market and I could probably get the / chocolates there too.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Good.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: So you’ll pick me up at a quarter to one at my place and I’ll make sure that I’ve got the presents.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: You must remember how much you paid for the gifts, so I can pay you back for half. If they’re going to be from both of us, I would like to go shares.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: OK. I’d say the chocolates would be about $15 for something nice and not too small and the toy would be around $35 or so, I’d think.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: Good, that’ll be fine. About $25 each then. Good, I’ll pick you up then on Sunday at twelve forty-five.

segments.speaker: JOHN
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: SARAH
segments.en: See you then. Bye.
